chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 244 – Ji Ning’s Nine-Year Powerup and the Ultimatum to Snowdragon
chapter_meta_description: After nine years of growth, Ji Ning faces the stubborn Snowdragon Mountain branch. A single calligraphy letter—and the sword-intent within it—changes everything.
og_title: The Letter That Burns – A Nine-Year Sword-Intent Tempered in Silence
og_description: Ji Ning’s calligraphy becomes a weapon as he delivers a ten-day ultimatum to the Snowdragon branch. Nine years of hidden growth erupt in one stroke.
twitter_title: Ji Ning just wrote the most terrifying ultimatum letter 😱🔥
twitter_description: Nine years later, Ji Ning’s sword-intent is so strong even his calligraphy terrifies Zifu cultivators. The Snowdragon branch has ten days to move—or else.

lore_anchors.definition: An evil, sin-laden cultivator whose combat power far exceeded normal peers, capable of fleeing from Primal Daoists—yet was killed by Ji Ning.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining, where a cultivator’s soul (Primal) is born, granting telepathic control of magic treasures and omni-directional divine sense.
The Grand Xia Dynasty’s elite immortal legion, requiring at least Wanxiang Adept level to join and earning contribution points through missions.
The Zifu Disciple overseer of Snowdragon City, left behind after the Xu clan’s Wanxiang Adept fled back to Snowdragon Mountain in fear of Ji Ning.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning write a letter instead of just attacking?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Directly assaulting a sect’s mountain gate is dangerous even for Immortals. Sending an ultimatum first gives the enemy a chance to retreat without bloodshed—and demonstrates Ji Ning’s absolute authority.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What kind of message is conveyed by burning the letter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The self-destructing restriction makes the warning final and non-negotiable—it’s a classic Xianxia intimidation tool, signaling that the writer does not expect or tolerate debate.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Xu clan leave only a Zifu overseer in Snowdragon City?
cultural_notes_faq.a: After Ji Ning casually killed Wanxiang Adepts like Xu Li, their Wanxiang leader fled back to the sect. Only a token manager was left, showing their true fear of facing Ji Ning directly.
